title: Accept supported Markus range (>=0.5.1,<1.0.0) in markus_renderer version check
description: assert_markus_version, convert_text_in_process and derive _markus_document require Markus exactly 0.5.1, so the Markus docs site (AnthusAI/Markus PR #9/#10) cannot build with Markus 0.6.0+. Decision (Ryan, 2026-10-18): accept the pyproject range >=0.5.1,<1.0.0; still fail on unparseable or out-of-range Markus. bodyIr records the actual Markus version. Follow-up: bump papyrus-newsroom pin in Markus docsite/requirements.txt after release.
right_now_summary: Update the version check to support Markus versions from 0.5.1 up to, but not including, 1.0.0.
